purpose.summary: Portable orchestration runtime for structured AI-assisted software development.
purpose.runtime_role: Routes, sequences, constrains, validates, records, and coordinates specialist AI-assisted development work without treating tool access, routing, governance success, validation success, or mergeability as authority.
purpose.core_trust_boundary: Permission and execution authority are explicit bounded inputs. Routing, host capability, governance disposition, validation evidence, compatibility certification, presentation mode, and GitHub state cannot independently grant or expand authority.

governed_ui_design_contract_uix1.purpose: Library-neutral evidence-bound UI Design Contract for source identity, design-system tokens, component reuse mappings, layouts, themes, assets, accessibility requirements, fidelity dispositions, and revision-bound validation state.
governed_ui_design_contract_uix1.authority_note: The UI Design Contract is evidence, not implementation authority. Figma, Code Connect, Storybook, Playwright, component libraries, and token tools remain optional capabilities; contract or validation evidence cannot grant or expand authority.

governed_ui_design_source_preservation_u.purpose: Library-neutral design-source intake and preservation workflow for source identity, evidence inventory, project-native component and token mapping, asset provenance, unresolved evidence, and pre-implementation handoff.
governed_ui_design_source_preservation_u.authority_note: UIX-2 preserves evidence and reports unresolved design inputs; it does not grant implementation authority, authorize dependency adoption, make external tools authoritative, or authorize Figma mutation.

governed_ui_design_profile_registry_uix3.purpose: Library-neutral UIX-3 registry separating foundations, layouts, complete themes or systems, and optional effects with deterministic composition and accessibility invariants.
governed_ui_design_profile_registry_uix3.authority_note: UIX-3 profile metadata constrains composition evidence only; profile names do not authorize arbitrary CSS, implementation, dependency adoption, external tools, validation bypass, or Figma mutation.

governed_ui_component_asset_preservation.purpose: Evidence-bound UIX-4 component mapping, variant and interaction-state coverage, semantic token preservation, asset provenance, substitution, and intentional-deviation contract.
governed_ui_component_asset_preservation.authority_note: UIX-4 preserves component and asset evidence; it does not grant implementation authority, authorize silent substitutions, add dependencies, make external tools authoritative, or authorize Figma mutation.

governed_ui_specialist_integration_uix5.purpose: Library-neutral UIX-5 flow for consuming governed UI evidence through the existing Conductor, Cloak, Clockwork, Governor, Ponytail, Overseer, and Arbiter workflow with explicit non-overlapping ownership.
governed_ui_specialist_integration_uix5.authority_note: UIX-5 sequences existing specialists and binds evidence to handoffs; it does not create a specialist, expand authority, make UI or rendered evidence approval, activate adoption, or authorize Figma mutation.

governed_ui_optional_adapter_boundaries_.purpose: Library-neutral UIX-6 audit and boundary contract for optional Figma, Code Connect, Storybook, Playwright, axe, and project-native design-token evidence capabilities.
governed_ui_optional_adapter_boundaries_.authority_note: UIX-6 records optional capability boundaries and explicit evidence limitations; it does not adopt dependencies, refresh installed integrations, create a Figma client, make external tools authoritative, or authorize Figma mutation.

adapter_sdk_and_prap_certification.purpose: Stable SDK import surface and read-only PRAP v1 compatibility certification for host and adapter integration authors.
adapter_sdk_and_prap_certification.authority_note: Certification proves compatibility only. It does not grant runtime authority, host maturity, deployment permission, policy activation, or installed refresh authority.

mcp_stdio_transport.purpose: Expose a bounded Orchestra tool surface to MCP-compatible clients while preserving existing PRAP, governance, runtime, and authority boundaries.

local_adaptive_memory_a1.purpose: Machine-local scoped adaptive observation evidence and derived preference profiles without routing, policy, authority, governance, provider, lifecycle, or training authority.
local_adaptive_memory_a1.authority_note: A1 adaptive memory is local evidence and derived preference state only. It cannot grant authority, alter governance, change deterministic routing, or automatically promote inferred candidates.

specialist_adaptive_context_a2.purpose: Opt-in read-only specialist context compiled from exact-scope A1 local state after existing route binding, authority, capability, and governance gates.
specialist_adaptive_context_a2.authority_note: A2 context is advisory only. It cannot select a different route, grant authority or capability, alter governance, or promote learned patterns.

behavioral_pattern_learning_a3.purpose: Machine-local shadow signal extraction, evidence-bounded candidate learning, and comparison against deterministic choices without inserting shadow state into the A1 materialized profile, A2 specialist context, routing, or execution.
behavioral_pattern_learning_a3.authority_note: A3 is shadow-only. Confidence is not authority; generic task success is not strategy-success evidence; shadow recommendations cannot affect deterministic execution or promote learned patterns.

bounded_adaptive_selection_a4.purpose: Canonical bounded A4 shadow selector, evidence qualification, and opt-in post-execution observation attachment with deterministic fallback and no execution authority.
bounded_adaptive_selection_a4.authority_note: A4 remains shadow-only and non-authorizing. Its canonical post-execution attachment cannot influence operation inputs, create eligibility, restore filtered options, expand authority/capability/provider access, change required specialist ownership, or control deterministic execution.

adaptive_tuner_topology_a5.purpose: Canonical bounded A5 shadow topology scorer and exact evidence-qualification layer under the frozen deterministic coordination contracts, closed without execution promotion because qualifying comparative benefit evidence was not established.
adaptive_tuner_topology_a5.authority_note: A5 is canonical and closed at shadow maturity. The shadow ranker cannot alter specialist ownership or deterministic ceilings, has no attachment to Conductor dispatch or RuntimeExecutor execution, and cannot be promoted from synthetic, generic, or unmeasured benefit evidence.

comparative_measurement_b0.purpose: Shared provenance-bound comparative measurement contract for isolated A5 topology testing, isolated Murmurs communication testing, and a later controlled interaction experiment without granting runtime promotion authority.
comparative_measurement_b0.authority_note: B0 freezes measurement and evidence contracts only. Benchmark evidence is not authority, A5 remains shadow-only, Murmurs benefit is not assumed, and A6 remains unauthorized.

comparative_measurement_b1.purpose: Shared non-production harness for provenance-bound paired comparative benchmark execution and evidence collection across isolated A5, isolated Murmurs, and later controlled interaction experiments.
comparative_measurement_b1.authority_note: B1 is evidence infrastructure only. It executes configured non-production benchmark arms, cannot let A5 select or suppress arms, does not establish A5 or Murmurs benefit, and grants no production runtime or promotion authority.

comparative_measurement_b2_1.purpose: Canonical benchmark-only sequential A5 topology execution adapter for scientifically valid isolated B2 measurement, without attaching A5 to production dispatch or RuntimeExecutor execution.
comparative_measurement_b2_1.authority_note: B2.1 canonically enables non-production topology measurement only. The shared harness selects every configured arm independently, A5 remains shadow-only, parallel execution is rejected, and B2.1 itself performed and authorized no live model calls or runtime promotion.

comparative_measurement_b2_2.purpose: Freeze the exact B2 topology-calibration identity and reconcile the completed bounded real calibration without treating calibration evidence as confirmatory benefit or runtime promotion authority.
comparative_measurement_b2_2.authority_note: The completed B2 calibration is valid calibration evidence only. The 10/10 versus 10/10 quality tie and descriptive efficiency differences do not establish A5 benefit or grant execution promotion. The consumed live authorization does not authorize reruns, A5 promotion, A6-A8, B4, release, deployment, policy activation, or destructive operations.

comparative_measurement_b2_3_1.purpose: Implement independently recomputable B2 specialist handoff evidence and exact Codex counter provenance before any new pilot or confirmatory execution.
comparative_measurement_b2_3_1.authority_note: B2.3.1 is evidence instrumentation only. It retains bounded synthetic handoff and host-counter provenance for later governed reconciliation, changes no production routing/runtime attachment, performs zero model calls in fixture validation, and grants no pilot, confirmatory, A5 promotion, A6, B4, release, deployment, or destructive authority.

comparative_measurement_b2_4.purpose: Execute and reconcile the separately authorized replacement B2.4 instrumentation pilot with complete evidence retention.

comparative_measurement_b2_5.purpose: Record the valid 40-run held-out confirmatory replacement and the preregistered B2 terminal conclusion.

comparative_measurement_b3_1.purpose: Record the completed B3 calibration, pilot, and 450-run held-out confirmatory evidence with separate trustworthy host-counter attribution and the preregistered terminal Murmurs conclusion.
comparative_measurement_b3_1.authority_note: B3 completed valid confirmatory measurement but did not establish Murmurs benefit. No semantic-authority expansion, production attachment, A5 promotion, release, deployment, or policy activation is authorized.

comparative_measurement_codex_baseline_r.purpose: Host-specific Codex CLI measurement adapter readiness and bounded prebaseline hardening for the controlled cross-host baseline without changing the frozen benchmark subject, task set, common runner, deterministic response validator, communication treatments, or accepted Antigravity run evidence.
comparative_measurement_codex_baseline_r.authority_note: Live diagnostic transport qualification succeeded on Attempt 2 after an isolated Git-worktree precondition repair. The formal Codex baseline remains 0/30 and unauthorized until this prebaseline remediation is validated and canonicalized under a separate merge gate.

comparative_measurement_codex_c1_reconci.purpose: Completed Codex C1 natural-language 30-run calibration reconciled against the frozen Antigravity B3 calibration while preserving provider-native counter boundaries and the single adjudicated Codex provider-outage attempt.
comparative_measurement_codex_c1_reconci.authority_note: C1 is calibration evidence only. Absolute provider-native token totals are descriptive and not a direct cross-provider efficiency ranking. C1 grants no runtime promotion, release, deployment, A5, A6, or B4 authority.

registry_adaptive_consumption_o1_o6.purpose: Negotiated Registry capability consumption, explicit trusted Registry v0.2.0 compatibility, multi-jurisdiction query selection, query-scoped freshness, release-delta impact analysis, and governed domain-to-specialist resolution.
registry_adaptive_consumption_o1_o6.authority_note: Registry capability, freshness, delta, and routing evidence cannot expand Orchestra authority, publish Registry state, bypass Conductor routing, or replace Governor/Steward/Arbiter evidence controls.

registry_query_optimization_o7.purpose: Consume the Registry R7 typed/indexed/projection query gateway using the smallest sufficient context while preserving O1-O6 semantics, exact Registry identities, existing compliance receipts, and fail-closed behavior.
registry_query_optimization_o7.authority_note: O7 is a planned read-path optimization only. MCP remains transport, the Registry index remains derived, query/projection choice cannot change compliance meaning, and no O7 path may expand authority or bypass existing evidence gates.

comparative_measurement_codex_c2_portabi.purpose: Completed Codex C2R1 machine-JSON calibration reconciliation, preserving the primary 29 accepted + 1 invalid provider-outage record and the separately labeled supplemental recovery sensitivity observation.
comparative_measurement_codex_c2_portabi.authority_note: C2R1 completed its governed primary execution with 29 accepted runs and one preserved provider-outage invalid observation. A separately authorized supplemental recovery passed but does not replace the primary invalid run. The result remains calibration evidence only and grants no C3, A5 promotion, A6, B4, release, deployment, or policy authority.

Package identity, version, command manifest, and installable specialist manifest
Compiled specialist identities and routing-relevant metadata
Deterministic command routing, direct routes, ordered sequences, aliases, and fallback
Governance vocabulary, precedence, ownership, validation rules, and remediation defaults
Host maturity and governed host-update planning contract
Adapter SDK / PRAP compatibility certification contract
Machine-readable specialist knowledge references and provenance-bound catalogs
Deterministic Murmurs presentation dispositions and required-explanation safety boundaries

Canonical semantic record of third-party dependencies, references, protocol sources, historical research, planned research, reviewed revisions, license state, learned patterns, affected surfaces, evidence, and incorporation boundaries

specialists.source_of_truth_note: Specialist prose and reasoning guidance remain in skills/*/SKILL.md; machine routing-critical metadata is compiled and parity-validated.

governance.effective_authority_model: selected_profile INTERSECTION explicit_grant INTERSECTION repository_policy INTERSECTION host_capability INTERSECTION current_phase INTERSECTION current_evidence

architecture.historical_status_policy: Phase documents may retain phase-era status wording. Current exact state comes from live machine contracts, release evidence, and Git identity.

knowledge_provenance.semantic_context_contract: Each provenance item records why Orchestra consulted it, reviewed revision state, license state, learned or incorporated patterns, affected Orchestra surfaces, evidence, and explicit source/runtime incorporation boundaries.
knowledge_provenance.historical_uncertainty_rule: Unknown historical facts remain explicitly unknown instead of being guessed.
knowledge_provenance.source_copy_policy: External references do not authorize wholesale source copying; provenance and incorporation boundaries remain explicit.

validation.murmurs_measurement_policy: Repository simulation may prove deterministic structural reductions such as fewer model-progress calls, but billing/model token deltas are reportable only when comparable live host-reported counters share the same counter identity. Unavailable token evidence remains unavailable rather than estimated.
validation.future_release_candidate_policy: Any future release candidate requires fresh exact-head runtime, branch, critical-module, mutation, Cosmic Ray, cross-platform, CodeQL/required-analysis, governance, documentation-parity, and release-identity evidence.
validation.evidence_policy: Runtime confidence claims must be derived from persisted machine-readable CI evidence bound to the tested checkout SHA and source-head SHA.

continuity.continuity_rule: Repository memory and handoffs cannot promote source state without verified Git/source evidence.

release_state.publication_identity_rule: Any future public release becomes authoritative only when the exact tag, immutable GitHub Release, and approved signed canonical commit identity are created and independently verified.

representation_policy.markdown: Human-readable explanation, rationale, examples, and nuanced specialist guidance
representation_policy.json: Canonical structured machine state, identity, routing, governance, receipts, manifests, provenance, presentation contracts, evidence, and indexes
representation_policy.jsonl: Append-only event/history records where incremental retrieval is preferable
representation_policy.toon: Derived validated non-authoritative model-context projection only when bounded compilation provides measured context benefit
representation_policy.parity_rule: When the same deterministic fact appears in more than one representation, CI must validate parity or derive the projection from one authoritative source.
